post.summary: Kicks off an asynchronous task that replicates all Keycloak users into the PDC users cache.
post.description: Creates a `userSyncTask` and enqueues a background job that walks the whole realm's user list at the Keycloak Admin REST API using the caller's own credentials, then merges it into the local `users` cache. The sync sets `disabledAt` for users that Keycloak reports as deleted or not enabled rather than deleting them. Poll `GET /users/sync/{userSyncTaskId}` for completion.

201.description: The created user sync task, initially pending.
